title: OpenOPs
description: A lightweight NeoForge mod that logs operator and admin commands in real time, promoting transparency and accountability on small Minecraft servers by publicly recording OP activity to chat or Discord.
body:
# 🛡️ OpenOPs

**Transparent operator logging for small Minecraft servers.**

OpenOPs is a lightweight NeoForge mod that logs operator and admin command usage in real time.
It helps small friend groups build trust by **publicly recording OP activity to Discord via webhook or directly in server chat**.

No more wondering if someone secretly switched to Creative.
No more silent `/give`, `/tp`, or `/gamemode`.

---

## ✨ Features

* 📜 Logs operator / admin commands
* 🔔 Sends formatted embeds to a Discord webhook
* 💬 Optional in-game broadcast logging
* ⚙️ Command whitelist / blacklist support
* 🧠 Lightweight & server-side only
* 🔒 Designed for transparency, not punishment

---

## 📸 Discord Integration

OpenOPs sends clean, readable embeds to your Discord server.

Screenshots below show:

* Command execution logs
* Player name + command used
* Timestamped entries

![Image showing off embed](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6246a632f2dae574cf75d424f492260d6694b60f.png)

---

## 🎯 Why OpenOPs?

Small servers run by friends rely on trust.
But when one person has OP, there's no built-in audit trail visible to everyone.

OpenOPs adds:

* Accountability
* Transparency
* Peace of mind
* A public record of administrative actions
  
---

## ⚙️ Configuration

Simple webhook-based setup:

1. Create a Discord webhook.
2. Paste the webhook URL into the config file.
3. Restart the server.

---

## 🧩 Compatibility

* Server-side NeoForge mod
* Does not require clients to install
* Designed for small to medium community servers

---

If you’re running a small SMP with friends and want a simple way to prevent OP abuse — this is for you.
